full_page.content:
1939, February 13
The following is a faithful transcription of a photo copy of a handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M.Cap.
ST. BONAVENTURE'S MONASTERY 1740 MT. ELLIOTT AVENUE DETROIT, MICH.
Feb. 13, 1939
Mr. Kelly, Sr. of Kelly, Kelly Kelly Co. 2444 Nat. Bank Bld'g, City
Dear Mr. Kelly :-
God bless you and yours, I hope you are well. I hope too that I may not be presuming too much in asking your- self of whom I have only heard, to guide the bearer, honest Edmund Walsh to employment, if you have anything in view.
I would appreciate anything you might find convenient to do for him.
Very Sincerely Yours, Fr. solanus, O.M. Cap.
Original in possession of: Mrs. Anna Gray 739 Harding Detroit, Mich. 48214
